title: Classify future Filter Controller type taxonomy
description: Create a taxonomy for current, variant, future, shared-module, configuration-only, and out-of-scope filter type ideas before any new filter type is implemented.
objective: Prevent new filter ideas from being coded directly into the widget without deciding whether they are real types, variants, subdomains, or configuration.
expected_outputs: Shared module versus real type decision criteria
Rule for creating future TASK-FC implementation tasks
acceptance_criteria: Search, checkbox, radio, select, chips, toggle, range, date, swatch, and rating are identified as current supported types.
Candidates such as number, text, multi-select, taxonomy tree, autocomplete, date preset, availability/status, geo/distance, boolean group, and media swatch are classified before implementation.
The task distinguishes variants from real types, for example dual-handle range as a Range variant unless the architecture proves otherwise.
The task distinguishes shared modules from types, for example layout packing, dynamic tags, sort, pagination, active chips, and loading states.
No future type implementation task is opened without a classification entry and dependency plan.
verification: Classification cites FilterTypeRegistry and existing audit tasks.
No plugin source implementation is made by this task.
Taxonomy document exists and classifies current supported types, variants, future candidates, shared modules, configuration-only ideas, and deferred/out-of-scope items.

budgets.context_budget: FilterTypeRegistry, audit synthesis, current and proposed filter surfaces
budgets.research_budget: local source and existing audit docs

risks: Treating variants as new types can explode code and UI complexity.
Treating real types as simple variants can make the widget fragile and confusing.
Future type work can bypass modularization if this taxonomy is not used as a gate.
verification_results: Read FilterTypeRegistry current definitions: search, checkbox, radio, select, chips, toggle, range, date, swatch, rating.
Read TASK-FC-034 through TASK-FC-043 audit packets.
No plugin source implementation was made.
notes: Number and text exact inputs are deferred candidates, not automatic new types.
Multi-select dropdown, taxonomy tree, autocomplete, and geo/distance are future real type candidates because they change interaction, value shape, source, or resolver contracts.
Date preset remains a Date variant unless it becomes a custom calendar engine.
Availability/status remains configuration across Radio, Checkbox, Toggle, or Select unless a distinct status state model is proven.
Media swatch remains a Swatch variant unless media selection/source storage changes the data contract.
Future type work must cite this taxonomy before a new registry key or implementation task is opened.
